_comment: The DE156's view of the MLC (deco_mlc.cpp decomlc_no146_map, decomlc_146_map): the avengrgs addresses without the 0xff000000 mirror, the ARM's 26-bit space (addr_hi 0x3ffffff), little-endian. Select with CORE_REGIONS=regions_de156.json. vectors: the ARM's eight exception vectors 0x00-0x1f; the scanline IRQ enters at 0x18. stadhr96 adds the DECO 146 at 0x70f000-0x70ffff, inside trace.io. The rest as regions.json. linelog: regions written mid-frame (stadhr96 rewrites the raster words on every line, docs/write_timing_mame.txt), logged with the scanline read at scanline (mlc_scanline_r). wtap irqregs: the IRQ block as written (rebuilt from writes since power-on, reg_irqregs.bin and _prev): words 0, 1, 28, 29, 31 read back constants or counters, not what was written, and word 1 is the alpha word.
